title: Crestline Battery Sale Tickets: Fitment and Ticket Charges under the Battery Replacement Warranties
content:
**Fitment.** A battery is sold in a BCI group listed for the vehicle, and a start-stop vehicle is fitted only with a line that is start-stop compatible.

**The ticket.** The ticket for a battery sold with a Battery Replacement Warranty is the total of:

1. the shelf price of the line;
2. for an installed battery, the line's under-hood installation fee where the battery sits under the hood, or the line's installation fee for a battery under a seat, in the trunk or behind components where it sits there;
3. the line's battery management system registration charge, when the vehicle requires battery registration;
4. the line's recycling handling fee;
5. the line's core deposit, when no core is handed in on the ticket.

Carry-out sales carry no installation fee and no registration charge. Terminal service (terminal cleaning and anti-corrosion treatment) and a memory saver are part of every installation and are not separate lines on the ticket.

**What the sale opens.** Each battery sold, installed or carried out, opens its warranty on the date of the ticket. Where no core is handed in, the core deposit is collected on that ticket. A ticket paid with the Crestline Credit Card posts to the card account as a card purchase; a ticket charged to a Crestline Fleet Account posts as a fleet invoice.

## Which charges arise

| Charge | Installed, under the hood | Installed, under a seat, in the trunk or behind components | Carried out |
|---|---|---|---|
| Shelf price of the line | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Under-hood installation fee | Yes | No | No |
| Under-seat, trunk or component-removal installation fee | No | Yes | No |
| Registration charge | when the vehicle requires battery registration | when the vehicle requires battery registration | No |
| Recycling handling fee | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Core deposit | when no core is handed in | when no core is handed in | when no core is handed in |

## Hypothetical worked ticket

The figures below are invented for illustration and are not any line's prices. Suppose a line with a shelf price of 150.00, an under-seat installation fee of 30.00, a registration charge of 20.00, a recycling handling fee of 0.00 and a core deposit of 25.00.

- Installed under a seat, in a vehicle that requires battery registration, with no core handed in: 150.00, plus 30.00, plus 20.00, plus 0.00, plus 25.00, a ticket total of 225.00.
- The same battery carried out with no core handed in: no installation fee and no registration charge, so 150.00 plus 0.00 plus 25.00, a ticket total of 175.00.
- The same carry-out sale with an old battery handed in on the ticket: no core deposit, so a ticket total of 150.00.
